description: Source code for generating TypeScript definitions, validators, and protocol metadata for Playwright's protocol channels, including parsing protocol YAML, generating type definitions, and writing output files.

methods.name: raise
methods.description: Throws an error for invalid items during type processing.

methods.name: titleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case (first letter uppercase).

methods.name: inlineType
methods.description: Recursively converts protocol types to TypeScript and scheme representations.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Generates TypeScript and scheme definitions for object properties.

methods.name: objectType
methods.description: Creates TypeScript and scheme definitions for object types.

methods.name: addScheme
methods.description: Adds a scheme definition to the validator TypeScript code.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes content to a file if it differs from existing content.
